subject: Northwind MAP & marketplace private-offer — evaluation milestones and PO path
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@northwind.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Northwind MAP & marketplace private-offer — evaluation milestones and PO path

Hi Sara — great to meet last week. Per our call, I sketched a concise mutual action plan (MAP) so Northwind can complete a short staged evaluation and land on the AWS private offer with a predictable billing/onboarding path. High-level objectives:

- 2-week staged eval (pilot workload on dev cluster)
- Security review & procurement signature to complete PO and private-offer activation
- Billing alignment: AWS private-offer invoice flows -> Northwind AP team, with Redwood consolidated invoice for usage credits

Draft MAP attached (NW-MAP-v1.2.pdf) and the private-offer term sheet (private-offer-terms.pdf). Key asks for this week:
1) Procurement contact + required PO fields (vendor name, remit address, tax id)
2) Confirmation on pilot start date (we suggested Mon 4/26)
3) Any contract redlines to route to our legal team

If that looks good I’ll loop in our finance to prepare the billing checklist and a sample invoice flow to share with your AP team.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0129

Attachments: NW-MAP-v1.2.pdf (MAP draft, 6pp); private-offer-terms.pdf (term summary, 3pp)

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@northwind.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@northwind.com>, Ben Cho <ben.cho@cloudbroker.io>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northwind MAP & marketplace private-offer — evaluation milestones and PO path

Thanks Naomi — this is helpful. Quick answers:

- Procurement lead: Megan Park (procurement@northwind.com) — will stay CC'd on procurement threads.
- Pilot start: 4/26 works for the engineering team; aim for a 10-business-day pilot window.
- PO fields: Northwind requires vendor legal name, remit address, PO number, and W-9 for US vendors.

A few clarifying asks from my side:
- Can you confirm whether the private-offer commitment is purely usage-based or if we need a minimum monthly spend to secure the private-offer pricing?
- For billing, will Redwood provide a consolidated invoice for the private-offer charges or will charges flow directly through AWS with your private-offer discounts reflected? I need this detail before I route to AP.

Also looping Ben from our cloud broker to help map the AWS private-offer activation steps.

Thanks,
Sara
Procurement Operations
Northwind Logistics

On Mon, Apr 19, 2027 at 09:12 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [original message attached]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Northwind MAP — operational checklist and billing path proposal

Naomi / Karthik — following Sara's notes, here's a short ops checklist I propose we use to keep the MAP tight and reduce procurement back-and-forth: 

1) Pilot readiness (owner: Eng on both sides)
   - Pilot SOW: deploy sample inference workload, success criteria (latency < 120ms p95, cost per 1k tokens estimate)
   - Data handling: no PHI, test dataset only, logging TTL 30 days
2) Security/compliance (owner: Karthik)
   - Provide SOC2 attestation and encryption-in-transit docs (we have a short pack)
3) Procurement & legal (owner: Naomi)
   - Provide vendor remit, W-9, and private-offer term sheet; ask for PO template
   - Offer: usage-based private-offer; no minimum, but discounted unit pricing requires committed 3-month baseline (we can convert to credits on Redwood invoice)
4) Billing flow (owner: Finance, cc Naomi)
   - Option A (preferred): Redwood issues consolidated monthly invoice to Northwind for private-offer usage credits; Redwood bills AWS and passes through discounts (simpler for AP)
   - Option B: AWS invoices Northwind directly with private-offer discount; Redwood provides monthly report to reconcile usage/credits

Action items for today: Naomi to confirm which billing option we recommend; Karthik to stage the security packet for Sara/Procurement. I can prepare a short pilot SOW template to attach to the MAP.

—Jordan
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@northwind.com>, Procurement <procurement@northwind.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northwind MAP & marketplace private-offer — evaluation milestones and PO path

Sara / Megan — thanks for the quick turnaround. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

- Billing model: we recommend Option A (Redwood consolidated invoice). That reduces AP friction — Redwood will invoice Northwind monthly for private-offer usage and settle with AWS. We will include a usage credit line-item (for any committed baseline) so it maps to your accounting.
- Commit terms: to qualify for the private-offer discounted tiers we ask for a 3-month soft commitment that we convert to credits on the Redwood invoice; there is no hard enforced minimum billing via the marketplace.

Next steps: 
- Attached updated MAP (NW-MAP-v1.2.pdf) and private-offer terms (private-offer-terms.pdf).
- Megan — could you confirm the PO template fields and where we should send the signed PO? We typically accept PDF PO via AP email; if you prefer DocuSign we can use that too.
- Karthik will attach a brief security pack by EOD with SOC2 summary + encryption notes.

I’ll get Finance to prepare a sample invoice flow doc and a short billing FAQ for your AP team.

Best,
Naomi

Attachments: NW-MAP-v1.2.pdf; private-offer-terms.pdf
